label: copy-phase input f/j (recall_idx >= 3), boosted when outputting m/e
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original or delimiter steps), almost exclusively when the fed-back input is f or j (~95% of activations and mass; rare n/c/e). Concentrated at recall_idx 3-5 (never at recall_idx 0-1). Magnitude is highest when the token being output is m (and to a lesser degree e, 0, 1, h), e.g. the top examples are f/j followed by m or e. Precision is very low (~1.5%): the vast majority of copy-phase f/j inputs do not cross the threshold, and adding out_tok/next_out conditions raises precision only to ~7-14% at large recall cost, so the gating context beyond input identity was not captured. Does not fire on f/j during the original phase.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=j (+5.59), phase=2 & in_tok=f (+5.48), phase=2 & out_tok=m (+3.18), phase=2 & out_tok=e (+2.82), phase=2 & in_tok=n (+2.64), phase=2 & out_tok=0 (+2.12).
